newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gold Mines of Australia CEO resigns.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gold Mines of Australia CEO resigns.

text.p: Gold Mines of Australia (GMA) said on Monday chief executive Stephen Everett had resigned for family reasons and the gold miner had formed a new executive committee with two new executive general managers.

"The board is grateful to Mr Everett for his contributions to the development of Gold Mines of Australia and wishes him well. Mr Everett has agreed to enter into a consultancy arrangement with the company," GMA said in a statement.
It said the new executive committee would comprise chief financial officer, Craig Munro, and two senior operations managers, Tim Moran and Hamish Bohannan.
Moran would become executive general manager, gold, and Bohannan would becomes executive general manager, metals.

GMA chairman Malcolm Block, who will be acting chief executive, said "the promotion of younger, talented mangers provided an opportunity for them to play a direct role with the Board which should benefit shareholders."
GMA said it approved further exploration funding to conduct the next stage of drilling at the promising NOA2 area, Reedy Gold Mine in Western Australia.
"Additionally, the Company is presently evaluating options for expanding the Mt Lyell Copper Mine in Tasmania."
GMA's shares were down half a cent at 20 cents at 1.40 p.m. (0240 GMT). -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
